e01_generic_function.title: a generic function has a list of types before its parameters; the call infers the types or writes them (D-148)

e02_generic_procedure.title: a generic procedure takes a list of types; the call infers it or writes it (D-148)

e03_generic_method.title: a method has its own list of types, in a generic class or in a plain class (D-148)

e04_generic_process.title: the process of an aspect takes a list of types; apply infers it or writes it (D-148); one Eve macro (D-152)

e05_overload_types.title: functions and procedures share a name when the types of their parameters differ (D-149)

e06_overload_count.title: functions and procedures share a name when the number of their parameters differs (D-149)

e07_overload_result.title: functions that differ only by the type of the result: the type expected at the call selects one (D-149)

e08_overload_ambiguous.title: a call that does not fix the type of the result of an overloaded function is ambiguous: compile error (D-149)
e08_overload_ambiguous.reason: expected output not found: 'ambiguous call of unit'

e09_overload_defaults.title: a default value can make two signatures match the same call: compile error (D-149)
e09_overload_defaults.reason: expected output not found: 'ambiguous call of f'

e10_overload_no_match.title: a call that matches no signature of an overloaded name is a compile error (D-149)
e10_overload_no_match.reason: expected output not found: 'no signature of half matches'

e11_function_procedure_name.title: a function and a procedure never share a name: compile error (D-149)
e11_function_procedure_name.reason: expected output not found: 'report is both a function and a procedure'

e12_same_signature.title: two declarations with the same signature are a compile error (D-149)
e12_same_signature.reason: expected output not found: 'half is declared twice with the same signature'

e13_method_result_or_not.title: a method without a result and one with a result share a name: a statement calls the first, an expression the second (D-149)

e14_generic_lambda.title: a lambda has no list of types: compile error (D-148)
e14_generic_lambda.reason: expected output not found: 'a lambda has no type list'

e15_type_not_inferred.title: a type that the arguments do not give must be written at the call: compile error (D-148)
e15_type_not_inferred.reason: expected output not found: 'can not infer the type T of make'

e16_macro_apply.title: an Eve macro: shared declarations, an exclusive aspect and the driver in one file (D-152)

e17_macro_parallel.title: an Eve macro starts its concurrent aspects in a parallel group; a shared class carries the results (D-152)

e18_macro_atomic.title: concurrent aspects of a macro add to a shared atomic variable: the total is exact (D-152, D-132)

e19_macro_unsafe_variable.title: a concurrent aspect of a macro can not use a shared variable that is not atomic: compile error (D-152)
e19_macro_unsafe_variable.reason: expected output not found: "uses 'count', which is not thread safe"

e20_macro_unsafe_procedure.title: a concurrent aspect of a macro can not call a shared procedure that changes a plain variable: compile error (D-152)
e20_macro_unsafe_procedure.reason: expected output not found: "calls 'bump', which is not thread safe"

e21_macro_two_drivers.title: a macro has one driver: a second one is a compile error (D-152)
e21_macro_two_drivers.reason: expected output not found: 'a macro has only one driver'

e22_macro_statement.title: a statement outside a declaration is a compile error in a macro (D-152)
e22_macro_statement.reason: expected output not found: 'a statement outside a declaration in a macro'
